_comment: Cases for MRR.Tests/BoardImportEvalTests. Corners are in pixels of the photo file, in importer order TL,TR,BR,BL (hand-placed; the importer refines them). 'truthBoard' = a .srx saved from the DB, 'truthGrid' = a hand-labelled token file (category only). 'overrides' = cells where the physical board differs from its truth, as 'col,row': token. 'floor' = the lowest score the test accepts (measured minus 2 points, 2026-11-06; reviewRecall = share of wrong cells flagged for review, maxFlaggedShare = ceiling on the share of all cells flagged, so flagging everything does not pass); raise it when the importer improves. heldOut=true means the case was never used to tune the importer.
